about: The bridge from Right Cut into Return Cut (katana.k_l1 into katana.k_l2), milestone-1 task 33: Return Cut's first 8 frames, starting in Right Cut's pose at its branch point (frame 17) and carried into Return Cut's own wind-up, the feet where Return Cut has them.
